units.source_text: 此时正是秋后十月中旬，“庙宇墙上葛，……亦已变颜色”。

en.t: It was now the middle of the tenth month after autumn had passed, when even the ivy on the temple walls had already changed color.

units.source_text: 松原下的树木上早有红叶，可知这里不是“但闻风吹声，始知秋已及”的地方。

en.t: The trees beneath the pine grove already bore red leaves, so this was clearly not a place where one only knew autumn had come by hearing the wind blow.

units.source_text: 大规模的高丽乐和唐乐，倒不及听惯的东游乐来得亲切可爱，乐声与风浪之声相呼应。

en.t: Grand performances of Korean and Chinese music could not match the familiar charm of the Azuma-asobi, whose music answered the sound of the wind and waves.

units.source_text: 与高树上的松涛声相竞争的笛声，异于他处所闻，嘹亮之音沁人心肺。

en.t: The flute seemed to vie with the roar of the pines in the tall trees, unlike anything heard elsewhere, and its clear tone sank deep into the heart.

units.source_text: 这笛声与琴声相和合，不用太鼓加强拍子，故无喧嚣嘈杂之音，而有幽雅闲静之感。

en.t: The flute blended with the koto, and because no great drum was used to strengthen the beat, there was no noisy clamor, only a refined and tranquil feeling.

units.source_text: 在这风景佳处演奏，音节特别优美。

en.t: Played in such a beautiful setting, the melody sounded especially lovely.

units.source_text: 舞人衣上用蓝绿色印成的竹节纹样，与松叶的绿色相混淆。

en.t: The bamboo-joint patterns printed in blue green on the dancers' robes blended with the green of the pine needles.

units.source_text: 诸人冠上装饰着的各种插头花，与秋花相掩映，难于分辨。

en.t: The many kinds of flowers decorating everyone's caps mingled with the autumn blossoms, making them hard to distinguish.

units.source_text: 形形色色，缤纷灿烂，令人目眩。

en.t: The variety of shapes and colors was brilliant and dazzling, enough to make the eyes swim.

units.source_text: 东游乐奏完《求子》曲之后，王侯贵族中年轻之人，都把官袍卸到肩下，走下庭中舞场里来。

en.t: After the Azuma-asobi finished the piece Koago, the younger princes and nobles all slipped their court robes down to their shoulders and came down into the dance ground in the garden.

units.source_text: 他们卸下朴素的黑袍，突然露出暗红色或淡紫色的衬袍襟袖和深红色的衣袂来。

en.t: As they cast off their plain black robes, the collars and sleeves of dark red or pale purple underrobes and deep crimson hems suddenly came into view.

units.source_text: 正当此时，天上降下一阵微雨，四周景物稍稍滋润。

en.t: Just then a light shower fell from the sky, and the surrounding scene grew slightly moist and refreshed.

units.source_text: 令人忘记了这地方是松原，而误认为散下了满地红叶。

en.t: It made one forget that this was a pine grove and imagine instead that red leaves had been scattered all over the ground.
Their dancing figures were extraordinarily pleasing to the eye.

units.source_text: 头上高高地插着雪白的荻花枯枝，略舞一会，立即隐去。

en.t: With snow white withered sprigs of ogi grass set high in their hair, they danced for only a short while and then quickly disappeared.

units.source_text: 姿态美丽之极，教人越看越不餍足。

en.t: Their forms were supremely beautiful, making one feel less and less satisfied the more one watched.
